//: What: Root of the npm workspace: declares all packages under packages/*, shared dev tooling and the check scripts.
Why: One install and one command (npm run check) run lint, header check, type check and all tests across every tool.
If missing or unlinked: Workspaces are not linked (@sapdx/* imports fail), and CI has no lint/typecheck/test entry points.
name: sap-dev-accelerators
description: Golden-path generators, clean-core gates, OData test generation, S/4 mocks and release-readiness checks for SAP RAP/CAP development.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
